whatsNew:
• Fixed BYD Dolphin & Atto 3 Flashing Red Border on Turn Signal: Purged uncalibrated Area 1000 cluster registers and decoupled generic BSD system state (ADAS_BSD_STATE / INSTRUMENT_BLIND_AREA) from directional visual alert layers.
• Canonical BYD Radar Alarm Architecture: Directional warning indicators now strictly bind to genuine Area 1038 ADAS hardware registers (1098907692 FL / 1098907694 FR / 1098907664 LCA Left / 1098907666 LCA Right) with 1500ms CAN pulse hold smoothing.
• New Radar Warning Frame Preference Switch: Added toggle switch in Settings (adas_bsd_warning_enabled) allowing users to easily enable or disable visual red alert frames as desired.
• Full Bilingual Localization: Updated base English strings and full Thai localization across all settings, diagnostics, and probe interfaces.
